title: Source pack upsert
summary: Registers or updates a manufacturing source pack and maps it into the cowd structured-data core.
current_return: source_pack, request_id, session_id, changed_refs when the backend accepts the pack
kernel_boundary: MFG owns the manufacturing source-pack schema; cowd owns the structured source index exposed at /api/cowd/structured/sources.

title: Connector run
summary: Runs a connector against an existing source pack through an explicit dry-run or live mode.
current_return: run object with run_id, mode, requested_capability, status
kernel_boundary: Connector authorization remains in cowd gateway/cross-plane; MFG only provides manufacturing source context.

title: Manufacturing fact ingest
summary: Ingests real manufacturing facts after source_ref and fact_type validation.
current_return: facts, request_id, session_id, changed_refs and downstream attention references
validate: client field validation plus structured ingest-plan
kernel_boundary: Facts are persisted in cowd structured data; MFG contributes manufacturing fact types and incident workflows.

title: Entity upsert
summary: Creates or updates a manufacturing entity such as line, station, product, batch, or quality issue.
current_return: entity with entity_id, canonical_key, confidence and source keys
kernel_boundary: Entity graph semantics belong to cowd structured/memory core; MFG supplies manufacturing taxonomy and source keys.

title: Relation upsert
summary: Connects manufacturing entities and updates impact traversal paths.
current_return: relation with confidence and affected entity references
kernel_boundary: Relations are cowd structured graph state; MFG only sets manufacturing domain-specific relation types.

title: Metric compute run
summary: Runs a planned metric compute job for selected manufacturing facts and entities.
current_return: job with status, metric_ids, affected refs and compute outcome
kernel_boundary: cowd structured core stores fact lineage; MFG owns manufacturing metric definitions and cockpit thresholds.

title: Evidence packet build
summary: Builds a traceable evidence packet from structured facts, attention items, and incident context.
current_return: packet/evidence_packet with packet_id, references and quality inputs
validate: problem statement and attention id checks
kernel_boundary: Evidence references come from cowd structured/context core; MFG packages them for manufacturing incidents.

title: Incident create and analyze
summary: Creates a manufacturing incident and links it to analysis, evidence, agents, skills, and memory cases.
current_return: incident and incident_id; analysis endpoints return operational_analysis and recommended_actions
kernel_boundary: Incident workflow is MFG application state; memory cases and agent task graph are cowd core integration points.

title: Action execute and cross-plane bridge
summary: Executes a recommended incident action and optionally bridges it to cross-plane delivery.
current_return: execution with mode, outcome, action_id and bridge receipt when available
kernel_boundary: cross-plane policy and identity remain cowd core; MFG supplies action intent and incident evidence.

title: Cockpit report generate
summary: Generates an operator cockpit report from manufacturing facts, metrics, incidents, and evidence.
current_return: report with report_id, profile_id, delivery_state and rendered sections
kernel_boundary: Report rendering is MFG application output; data lineage and delivery identity are cowd core responsibilities.

title: Cockpit report delivery retry
summary: Retries delivery of an existing cockpit report through cross-plane capabilities.
current_return: delivery receipt or queued human-review state
kernel_boundary: Delivery uses cowd cross-plane; MFG controls report semantics and recipient intent.
